description: React component for rendering and managing a thread viewer in Mattermost, including thread fetching, WebSocket updates, and UI rendering.

classes.name: ThreadViewer
classes.description: React component class for viewing and interacting with message threads in Mattermost.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Initializes thread read status and fetches app bindings when component mounts.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Updates WebSocket active thread status on unmount.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates when props change, such as reconnects or thread selection changes.

methods.name: morePostsToFetch
methods.description: Determines if more posts are available to fetch in the thread.

methods.name: getReplyCount
methods.description: Returns the reply count for the selected post or thread.

methods.name: fetchThread
methods.description: Fetches thread data if following a post.

methods.name: markThreadRead
methods.description: Marks the current thread as read, updating last viewed and read status.

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Initializes thread data, updates last update timestamp, and manages WebSocket scope.

methods.name: handleCardClick
methods.description: Handles user clicking on a post card to select it.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the thread viewer UI, including loading state and thread content.
